Name: ProcessIT Innovations
Description:
ProcessIT Innovations is a collaboration centre in northern Sweden. The strategic concept of ProcessIT Innovations is to bring together the functional process and engineering industry in the region with ICT (information and communication technology) services in universities and industry.

The aim is to reinforce existing primary industries and develop the region’s ICT-industry to an internationally competitive position. This concept meets the challenges faced by today’s knowledge-intensive, high-technology primary industry with the extensive knowledge developed by the region’s ICT services. Process IT’s vision is therefore to establish in the area a leading European R&D centre in ICT for primary industry.

ProcessIT has good potential for growth. The combination of the traditional process industry with the information and communications industry forms an area of regional strength and renewal. There is a good existing R&D infrastructure in Luleå and Umeå. The demand for R&D that exists to raise ProcessIT to a level of international competitiveness is well defined. Regional roots and leadership are top class, and regional authorities are contributing with very good co-financing. However, the task is so wide that focusing needs to be considered.

ProcessIT Innovations was started up on the initiative of trade and industry in the region. Today its activities involve the process and engineering industries, ICT companies and the universities of Umeå and Luleå. In addition the four coastal municipalities and the county administrative boards of Västerbotten and Norrbotten are involved. The strength of ProcessIT Innovations’ strategic concept lies in the interest and power that these
players have in the innovation system.

Att sälja mät- och styrkort är ett kapitel för sig eftersom man måste ha kunskapen att hjälpa kunden välja rätt kort, rätt givare och sedan måste det till en lämplig drivrutin. Our systems reduce safety risks, deliver substantial cost savings, and bring scalability and flexibility to the structural maintenance of critical assets.

Reinforcing bolts are fundamental to structural safety. Safety Bolt’s sensor technology ensures precision installation and provides full-time remote monitoring — helping operators improve asset lifetime, avoid costly downtime, and enable predictive maintenance.

Our solution continuously monitors bolt strain in real time, giving operators the data they need to predict potential failures, mitigate risk, and properly schedule maintenance activities.

Validated with Bosch and Hilti, Safety Bolt combines engineering excellence and IoT intelligence to deliver measurable value: safer operations, extended asset life, and significant operational savings.

Name: LIMAB AB
Description:
Welcome to Dynalyse AB an innovative company specialised in product quality measurements in process lines. Typical measured parameters are strength, stiffness, density, moisture content, surface moisture and applied paint amount.

One type of quality measurement is the strength grading of timber/lumber, such as to the European grades C24, C30 and C40 and also to North American MSR grades like 1650 and 2100.

Dynagrade and Precigrader have been installed in more than 170 planer mills, sorting mills and glulam factories in 10 countries. Dynagrade No. 1 was installed already in 1997 and is still running at Hilmer Andersson in Sweden. These products are constantly evolving, are integrated with moisture meters and offer easy-to-use digital reporting tools. Newly developed products are one proof-loader for lumber bending tests – MT250 and a system for paint amount (coat weight) control and documentation – Paint Control.

Our values lead to longterm relationship with our clients, to offer robust and longterm reliable products and also to continuously develop and adapt our products. The latter comprises the task to maintain and expand grading approvals according to different standards, markets and timber species for example.

We are proud working with many of the best companies in the wood-industry. Our customers have mills with production volumes ranging from roughly 25000 cbm of sawn or planed timber to huge-volumes. Examples of customers are: Brinks Trä (SWE) Derome Timber (SWE) Domtar (CAN) Havesa Timber (FIN) JG Andersson (SWE) Moelven Timber (SWE, NOR) SCA Timber (SWE) Sodra Timber (SWE) Stora Enso Timber (SWE) Versowood (FIN) Vida (SWE), Ziegler (DE). Their markets comprise among others Europe, Japan and North America.

We represent Finna Group in Europe and can offer an extensive palette of moisture meters for various applications.

Name: HDD Sweden AB
Description:
Ultra Compact Servo Motors – The most compact on the market - Swedish Innovative Servo Motion Engineering Since 1994. 

HDD has a standard range of servo motors primarily aimed at all applications in the machine industry. E.g. solid shaft, ballscrew, hollow shaft, internal coupling, low voltage and open frame servo motors. 

Because of their high power and torque density the motors are excellent in for example robotic applications and they are very well suited for direct drive because of their high torsional stiffness and low cogging torque.

We have flexible development and production and can make any adaptations in order to provide you with the best motor for your specific application.

Our set up enable us to manufacture cost efficient custom and customized solutions in small volume giving our customers a competitive advantage.

With a legacy that dates back to 1994, when the renowned Swedish inventor Lennart Stridsberg had a vision of creating a high-performance, ultra-compact servomotor, our commitment to innovation has been unwavering. 

Lennart’s groundbreaking design led to the founding of HDD, with the mission to meet the tough requirements of surface mounting equipment. In 2001, we introduced the ICM 09 servomotor, which provided a competitive advantage in in-line stitching. Since then, we’ve continued our innovative journey, selling our cutting-edge servo motors across the world. 

Our compact servo motors, being half the size than a standard servo motor, are engineered for exceptional performance and endurance, and embodying the renowned quality of Swedish craftsmanship.  

Based in Tyresö, 18 min outside Stockholm, our in-house facilities allow us full control over design and production, ensuring every product meets the highest standards.  

Our team of experienced, solution-oriented technicians brings expertise from a wide range of industries, working together to provide innovative solutions for your needs.

Name: Flexbridge
Description:
The industry’s full transition to the new generation automation systems is going to take a long time. IceBlock distributed PLC platform is a key to enhance existing equipment with distributed intelligent control today. It is an ultimate future-proof solution that will allow a seamless transition to Industry 4.0

IceBlock nano-PLC is a powerful yet tiny and cost-effective device that is intended to be a node on the Internet of Machines. It can perform control of an intelligent mechatronic component collaborating with other such components wirelessly. It talks with other nodes peer-to-peer via the Internet Protocol, thus avoiding the plethora of obsolete field buses. IceBlock exists in the standard 4xInputs, 4xOutputs configuration, but it can be customized to particular interfaces of mechatronic devices.
